title: Trio of former Arizona defensive backs set to participate in NFL combine

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trio of former Arizona defensive backs set to participate in NFL combine
sources.description: Several former Wildcats are getting prepared to take part in the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine mainly coming from the Arizona secondary from this past season. Defensive backs Treydan Stukes, Dalton Johnson, and Genesis Smith met with the media Thursday before their on-field workout session Friday. The on-field workouts are a big factor on whether or […]
